config_audit_keys.description: Audit OS Keyring token health, backend status, and zero-plaintext secret compliance. The audit scans each config file that the settings merge: the global config file and the project config file. It also scans config.yaml and .devops/config.yaml in the current directory. Exits 0 only when the audit is compliant. Exits 1 when a config file holds a plaintext secret, or when a config file cannot be read or parsed, reporting it unaudited. The full report prints before the exit. The alert of a leak names two commands. `devops config set <key>` stores a credential in the keyring. Add `--from-file <path>` for a multi-line credential, such as a PEM key. `DEVOPS_CLI_CONFIG=<file> devops config unset <key>` removes the value from the file of the leak.

pr_check_readiness.description:
Validate PR merge readiness: conflicts, draft state, checks, review threads, grounding
and draft readiness.

Grounding applies where the base holds openspec/changes/. The PR targets the default branch.
It closes exactly one issue, an open issue of its own repository that holds a priority/*
label: a roadmap item. GitHub closes that issue when the PR merges. The PR
adds openspec/changes/archive/\<date\>-\<issue\>-\<slug\>/, which uv run devops openspec archive
writes for that issue's change. Only that archive writes openspec/specs/ and
openspec/changes/archive/. An implement pull request must have every task group ticked.

pr_monitor.description:
Wait until the checks of a PR settle, then name every blocker of its merge.

While a check runs or a Copilot review is active, it waits. Then it reports the blockers of
the merge-readiness verdict and of its review gate (requested changes, Copilot's review, an
approval of the head with --require-reviews). Exit 0: ready; 1: a check failed or could not
be read; 2: another blocker; 3: the timeout passed first.

pr_ready.description:
Mark a draft pull request as ready for review once draft readiness allows it.

It exits 1 for a refusal and 8 while a check runs. For an implement pull request, it names
each unticked task group. Every other blocker of the merge-readiness verdict prints as a
warning. --force skips the readiness check. It sets the Status of the roadmap item the pull
request closes to In Review.

review_export_feedback.description:
Append review verdicts to the JSONL feedback dataset, which `devops ai prompt-eval` reads.

Each session's findings.json and candidates.json are read, and only the findings whose
verdict the dataset does not hold yet are appended. An export that finds none leaves the
dataset as it was. Without --status only INVALIDATED verdicts are exported. The dataset
changes no prompt and no later review.

A subject reviewed more than once is exported once: its sessions share their findings by
fingerprint v2. Each finding has the newest verdict a person gave it in any of those
sessions, or else the verdict of the session that review history counts. --status selects
by that verdict. A session that records no subject, and a finding with no fingerprint v2,
are exported on their own.

Inspect structured findings for a review session.

is candidates.json: every finding the review raised, the ones verification invalidated
included, numbered for `devops review verify --candidate`.

roadmap_run.description: Run the roadmap jobs that are due, in order: metrics, then intake, refine and the alternatives check, and record each one's last success. Intake is due on an issue reopened or a new issue, and decides at most 5 candidates a run and keeps a record of those it left beside the schedule; refine is due every 17 minutes, on a first run, and after an intake that placed a critical fix or a P0 item; retitle is due every 61 minutes and on a first run; the alternatives check is due every 719 minutes and on a first run, and checks at most roadmap.alternatives.first_pass_limit items while an item has no check, and roadmap.alternatives.limit items after.
